findings.title: State-series hole semantics at the skipped 2008-11-28 week are unpinned; the addendum's 'exactly one affected weekly decision' bound silently assumes one of two divergent readings
findings.evidence: d1 state_formula samples s_t weekly at the last session of each ISO week and defines z_t over 'trailing 104 weekly observations'; at 2008-11-28 QQEW is absent so s_t is undefined for that week. Reading (a) propagation: every m_(t-i) whose endpoint is the hole is undefined, so z_t is undefined for ~104+13 weeks (~2008-12..2010-12) and every such decision is skipped — contradicting p0_addendum_representation_reconciliation.json rationale 'exactly one affected weekly decision'. Reading (b) reindex: the weekly series is indexed on available observations (104 obs spanning 105 weeks); exactly one decision skipped, and every post-hole z_t uses a subtly shifted window. The addendum freezes the decision-level rule (SKIP-AND-HOLD, verbatim consistent with d1 missing_data_failclosed) but neither D1 nor the addendum states which z-series reading binds.

The two readings differ on ~10% of weekly decisions (skip-vs-compute, shifted windows) in a cycle whose most likely death is an R0 rho landing near the 0.20 bar. Must be pinned before any rho.
findings.fix_direction: One-paragraph addendum: state series indexed on available weekly observations (no imputation, reindex reading), exactly one skipped decision, identical convention binding every shadow; warmup counted in available observations.

findings.title: Spearman uses ordinal ranks without tie correction
findings.evidence: m0_contract.py _rank assigns positional 1..n ranks via stable argsort; textbook Spearman requires midranks for ties. Binary ±1/0 weight vectors (the default weights_of representation) are massively tied, so target_weight_spearman is order-dependent and deviates from textbook Spearman. Mitigated: the pooled bar takes max with weight-Pearson (tie-robust), identical/anti-identical books still merge, and the suite treats the continuous book as the honest fixture (g3 docstring). G5 fixture values are correct as hand-computed.
findings.fix_direction: Either document the ordinal-rank convention in the frozen contract or switch to midrank averaging; no gate outcome at 1bc2f19b changes.
